outlooks.confidence: Tested on forecasts made 3 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul to 17 Oct: 59% of the days this model flagged did cross the line (2% would by chance), and it flagged 38% of the days that crossed it.
outlooks.details: Our own forecast, made before the period it covers. The Fire Weather Index, computed from the last 60 days of measured weather and the corrected forecast, reaches the "very high" class and this place's 95th percentile for the month on 4 days in a row. Fire also needs fuel and a spark, which no weather index can see. 9 Nov: index 29.3 (very high) against a usual worst of 25.57. 10 Nov: index 27.8 (very high) against a usual worst of 25.57. 11 Nov: index 28.2 (very high) against a usual worst of 25.57. 12 Nov: index 30.1 (very high) against a usual worst of 25.57.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-11-05, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Houston, Texas, United States, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the Fire Weather Index NASA POWER records for these days once they are available: correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.

outlooks.title: Extreme heat forecast for Lima, 6 Nov to 12 Nov
outlooks.issuedAtBasis: Timestamp of the numerical weather prediction model run, issued before the target window.
outlooks.confidence: Tested on forecasts made 3 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul to 17 Oct: 45% of the days this model flagged did cross the line (11% would by chance), and it flagged 59% of the days that crossed it.
outlooks.details: Our own forecast, made before the period it covers. Forecast daily highs, corrected by 0.8 °C for the difference between the forecast service and the 30-year record, reach this place's 95th percentile for the time of year on 7 days in a row, and its 99th on at least one. That line is moved up 0.4 °C for the warming this place's record shows since its middle year. 6 Nov: 25.3 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 7 Nov: 25.8 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 8 Nov: 25.6 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 9 Nov: 25.8 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 10 Nov: 25.2 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 11 Nov: 25 °C against a usual worst of 24.1 °C. 12 Nov: 24.9 °C against a usual worst of 24.1 °C.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-11-05, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Lima, Lima Province, Peru, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the daily maximum temperature NASA POWER records for these days once they are available: correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.
